F / IO

Four engagement phases

Make the outcome and boundaries explicit.

Scope the work around your environment. Agree deliverables and verification criteria before building.

  1. 01

    Understand

    Identify the desired outcome, required evidence, authoritative data, decision and action boundaries, and human responsibilities. Map the current infrastructure and workflow.

  2. 02

    Integrate

    Connect systems, APIs, databases, documents, infrastructure, identity and existing workflows. Prepare context from evidence and return validated outputs to the process people use.

  3. 03

    Govern

    Define agent identity, permissions, scope, approval gates, escalation, validation and audit requirements. Test the refused paths as well as the permitted ones.

  4. 04

    Operate & Improve

    Verify production outcomes, hand over operational knowledge and review corrections and exceptions. Test, review and release changes as explicit workflow revisions.

From data to action

Reasoning is one part of the workflow.

The same pattern supports IT operations and business processes. Data enters as evidence; it does not become authority.

  1. 01

    Enterprise data

    Use authoritative sources.

  2. 02

    Context preparation

    Select relevant evidence.

  3. 03

    AI reasoning

    Apply explicit instructions.

  4. 04

    Structured output

    Produce a defined result.

  5. 05

    Validation

    Check the result and evidence.

  6. 06

    Human / policy boundary

    Check permission before action.

  7. 07

    Existing workflow

    Integrate, verify and reconcile.

What stays with you

Your systems. Your judgment. Clear ownership.

Integrate AI into a real business workflow. Give each agent only the authority its role requires. Use systems and processes your organization already trusts. Verify, govern and audit what AI is allowed to do. Automation should make your people more capable, not remove them from accountable decisions.

More capable people. Accountable automation.

AI gathers information, connects evidence and prepares the work. People retain authority where judgment, risk or accountability matters.
